description: Stable machine-readable error codes shared by KW service responses and per-part event receipts. Codes are part of the frozen contract; messages are human text and must never echo credentials, secret values, bodies or raw backend errors.

entries.description: Request shape, types, lengths or forbidden unknown fields are invalid; nothing was committed.
entries.client_action: Fix the request; do not retry unchanged.

entries.description: Unknown contract/schema version or unsupported operation/shape for the installed contract.
entries.client_action: Upgrade or downgrade the adapter to a supported contract; never silently guess.

entries.description: KW's independent secret check found secret-bearing content that the adapter did not sanitize. No body is stored and no plaintext may be logged.
entries.client_action: DMA purges the suspect outbox body, updates its redaction policy, re-reads the native source and retries under a new body hash.

entries.description: Encoded payload, part size or part count exceeds the contract limits; nothing was committed.
entries.client_action: Split into complete verifiable part groups; never head-truncate.

entries.description: The X-DMA-Client binding is unknown, revoked, or does not cover the requested workspace/instance/actor scope.
entries.client_action: Register the local installation binding; model/tool input cannot choose another binding.

entries.description: The registered binding may not act on the requested workspace, project or actor.
entries.client_action: Use an authorized scope or ask the owner; do not retry with altered body text.

entries.description: The requested opaque source/event/revision/part does not exist or is not visible to this binding.
entries.client_action: Treat as missing evidence, not as a file-system path.

entries.description: Source detail fell outside retention or was withdrawn; provenance metadata remains but no body may be fabricated.
Same event key/revision was already stored with a different canonical payload. Never overwrite.
entries.client_action: Investigate the adapter bug or send a new revision via edit/redact.

entries.description: edit/retract/redact references a parent revision that is not yet durably known; the input is retained as pending dependency.
entries.client_action: Deliver the parent revision, then retry; do not drop the input.

entries.description: Cursor is bound to a different query/scope/watermark/restore epoch or the backend changed under it.
entries.client_action: Re-query from a fresh cursor; report the snapshot boundary.

entries.description: Backend restore/import has not been activated yet; reads may be stale and writes are limited.
entries.client_action: Retain local outbox and retry with backoff; surface status to the user.

entries.description: Local store, disk, lock or socket is unavailable; the request is not durable. This includes disk-full conditions.
entries.client_action: Keep the event in the durable outbox and retry with bounded backoff.

entries.description: Optional extraction model is unavailable; raw events and keyword search remain usable.
entries.client_action: Retry later with bounded backoff; do not lose raw source; degraded status must be explicit.

entries.description: Vector model/revision/dimension/normalization does not match the active index generation; semantic results are degraded until rebuilt.
entries.client_action: Rebuild the vector generation or continue with keyword-only results; never mix indexes.

entries.description: Unexpected internal failure; no credential, request body or backend stack trace may be returned or logged as plaintext.
entries.client_action: Retry with bounded backoff once; then report with request_id.
